summary: Node/Express rewrite of Rhisos Mobilya CRM (backend converted from FastAPI). Ran the full pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/test_rhisos_backend.py, 59 tests) against the new Node backend served through the preview URL — all 59 tests PASSED, response shapes identical to previous FastAPI implementation. Covered: auth (login, register, /auth/me, logout, refresh, brute-force lockout 429), customers CRUD + history, quotes (mixed VAT totals, TKF-YEAR-NNNN numbering, update preserving payments, status change, delete cascade), payments (paid_total, auto income transaction, delete removes txn), transactions (CRUD + filters + Excel export xlsx with type/date filters), dashboard stats + monthly-profit, settings persist, public quote no-auth, email quote to delivered@resend.dev (returns ok:true,email_id,to) and 400 when customer has no email. Frontend E2E smoke-tested via Playwright: login as admin -> dashboard renders stats and monthly-profit card, navigation to Customers/Quotes/Kasa/Settings works, add-customer flow works, export-excel button present. No console errors (only benign shadcn Dialog aria-describedby warnings). All test data cleaned up from MariaDB; admin user preserved.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby — accessibility warning only, non-blocking

critical_code_review_comments: server/index.js is ~510 lines and mixes routes/auth/middleware/static serving — acceptable for MVP but consider splitting into routes/*.js for maintainability.
GET /api/quotes issues N+1 queries (loadItems + loadPayments per quote in a for-loop) — will degrade with many quotes; consider a single JOIN or Promise.all.

monthly-profit uses `date<=?` with `${month}-31` which incorrectly excludes some dates on months <31 days if date strings are ISO — currently works because comparisons are lexicographic on YYYY-MM-DD; still fragile.
requireAuth loads user on every request (DB hit per API call) — cache or trust JWT claims for read-only fields to reduce DB pressure.
setAuthCookies always sets secure:true + sameSite:'none' — good for prod behind HTTPS ingress, but breaks local http dev; acceptable given preview env.
seed_data_creation: None persistent — all test rows deleted; login_attempts/settings/customers/quotes/quote_items/payments/transactions truncated; admin user preserved.
